Hi Dawn — great to meet you virtually and thanks for the docs.

Short answer: we do offer nonprofit/academic credits for PLG signups; we try to enable self-serve redemption where possible. To get this approved and applied to your org account I need:
- Confirmation of the team email domain (we can map credits to a domain or HubSpot company)
- A point of contact for billing/account (can be you)
- Expected start date and the preferred credit amount.

Proposal: we can issue an initial 150k token credit pool (redeemable via our self-serve credits page) while we onboard your devs. If the pilot ramps, we'll re-evaluate and fast-track more credits.

I've looped in Priyom (solutions engineering) in case they need to scope any promo limits, and Rachel (sales ops) to approve and execute issuance. Rachel — can you confirm the standard nonprofit credit attachment flow and whether we need a signed MOU for 150k?

Hi all — quick technical note from the SE side.

If the developers are self-hosting within the partner university environment (on-prem) we'll need to confirm model choices and token accounting; for hosted PLG signups it's straightforward — credit applies at org level and is consumed from the hosted billing account.

For 150k tokens: recommend restricting model family to our cost-effective open tiers (e.g., token-optimized variants) and setting a per-route quota to prevent unexpected spikes. I can prepare a sample config and a short runbook for the Greenleaf devs.

Dawn — is your team okay with restricting the initial credit usage to non-prod namespaces and limiting the default model to the cost tier we specify?

— Priyom
